LightningComponentBundle.description: A calendar where logged-in volunteers can see upcoming published shifts and sign up for them.

property.name: calendarTitle
property.label: Calendar Title
property.description: An optional heading shown above the calendar. Leave it blank to show no heading.

property.name: showPositionFilter
property.label: Show Position filter
property.description: Lets volunteers show only one position.

property.name: showInitiativeFilter
property.label: Show Volunteer Initiative filter
property.description: Lets volunteers show only one volunteer initiative.

property.name: showDateRangeFilter
property.label: Show Date Range filter
property.description: Lets volunteers choose a from date and a to date.

property.name: showStartTimeFilter
property.label: Show Start Time filter
property.description: Lets volunteers show only shifts that start at or after a time.

property.name: showEndTimeFilter
property.label: Show End Time filter
property.description: Lets volunteers show only shifts that end at or before a time.

property.name: showShiftLengthFilter
property.label: Show Shift Length filter
property.description: Lets volunteers show only shifts that are shorter than a number of hours.

property.name: showColorLegend
property.label: Show Color Legend
property.description: Shows a list of the positions on the calendar next to their colors.
